<blockquote>
<p>一次完整的 React + Vite 项目性能优化之旅，将首屏加载时间从 4 分钟降到 13 秒，节省 95% 流量成本。</p>
</blockquote>

<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-2">引言：一个触目惊心的发现</h3>
<p>最近团队同事比较忙，正好公司要做新的官网，我之前开发项目结尾就开始了官网的开发，这部分的一些首屏优化之前并没有做过，写代码的过程中也没有太考虑这方面的优化，开发进度一大半的时候，注意到network面板的请求数据大小，后就看到了这样的数据：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs">总请求：75 个
传输大小：58 MB
首屏加载时间（3G）：4 分 17 秒 😱
</code></pre>
<p><strong>4 分钟！</strong> 这意味着一个使用移动网络的用户需要等待超过 4 分钟才能看到我们的首页。</p>
<p>这不可接受。于是开始了一场性能优化之旅。</p>
<p><strong>优化后的数据</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-scss" lang="scss">总请求：<span class="hljs-number">54</span> 个 (-<span class="hljs-number">28%</span>)
传输大小：<span class="hljs-number">2.57</span> MB (-<span class="hljs-number">95.6%</span>)
首屏加载时间（<span class="hljs-number">3</span>G）：<span class="hljs-number">13.5</span> 秒 ⚡ (快了 <span class="hljs-number">94.7%</span>)
</code></pre>
<p>这篇文章将完整记录这次优化的全过程，包括遇到的问题、解决方案、技术原理，以及可以直接复用的工具和代码。</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-3">项目背景</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-4">技术栈</h4>
<ul>
<li><strong>前端框架</strong>: React 19 + TypeScript 5</li>
<li><strong>构建工具</strong>: Vite 7</li>
<li><strong>路由</strong>: React Router v7</li>
<li><strong>样式</strong>: Tailwind CSS v4</li>
<li><strong>组件库</strong>: shadcn/ui (基于 Radix UI)</li>
<li><strong>国际化</strong>: i18next + react-i18next</li>
<li><strong>包管理</strong>: pnpm</li>
<li><strong>代码质量</strong>: Biome</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-id="heading-5">项目规模</h4>
<ul>
<li><strong>页面数量</strong>: 8 个主要页面（Home, Innies, Foundry, Company, Community, Careers, JobDetail, NewsDetail）</li>
<li><strong>组件数量</strong>: 50+ 个组件</li>
<li><strong>图片资源</strong>: 18 个 PNG + 1 个 GIF</li>
<li><strong>代码行数</strong>: ~5000 行 TypeScript/TSX</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-6">第一步：性能诊断</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-7">发现问题</h4>
<p>使用 Chrome DevTools Performance 面板进行初步分析：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash" lang="bash"><span class="hljs-comment"># 打开 Chrome DevTools (F12)</span>
<span class="hljs-comment"># Network 标签 → 勾选 "Disable cache" → 刷新页面</span>
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/af6dc4c42caa45e6b14b12568a476936~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5Lmf5peg6aOO6Zuo5Lmf6Zu-5pm0:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1765707875&amp;x-signature=WmW1mDATlZM0YcLR8z5uRp%2BZNug%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>发现的问题</strong>：</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>巨大的图片文件</strong> 💥</p>
<ul>
<li><code>case-aerospace.png</code>: 6.4 MB</li>
<li><code>case-fusion.png</code>: 6.0 MB</li>
<li><code>industry-fusion.png</code>: 5.8 MB</li>
<li><code>placeholder.gif</code>: 7.7 MB (一个背景动图！)</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>所有页面同步加载</strong> 💥</p>
<ul>
<li>即使用户只访问首页，也要下载所有 8 个页面的代码</li>
<li>首屏加载了 CareersPage, CommunityPage, CompanyPage 等不需要的组件</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>没有加载优先级</strong> 💥</p>
<ul>
<li>关键首屏图片和非首屏图片一视同仁</li>
<li>没有使用 fetchPriority 或 loading="lazy"</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<h4 data-id="heading-8">量化目标</h4>
<p>制定明确的优化目标：</p>









































<table><thead><tr><th>指标</th><th>当前</th><th>目标</th><th>达成标准</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>首屏资源</td><td>58 MB</td><td>&lt; 5 MB</td><td>Good</td></tr><tr><td>网络请求</td><td>75</td><td>&lt; 60</td><td>Good</td></tr><tr><td>3G 加载时间</td><td>257 秒</td><td>&lt; 20 秒</td><td>Excellent</td></tr><tr><td>图片格式</td><td>PNG</td><td>WebP</td><td>Modern</td></tr><tr><td>路由策略</td><td>全同步</td><td>懒加载</td><td>Optimized</td></tr></tbody></table>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-9">第二步：图片优化 - PNG 转 WebP</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-10">为什么 WebP？</h4>
<p>WebP 是 Google 开发的现代图片格式，相比 PNG：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>压缩率提升 70-95%</strong></li>
<li><strong>视觉质量几乎无损</strong></li>
<li><strong>浏览器支持率 97%+</strong></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>技术原理</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>PNG 使用 DEFLATE 压缩算法（1996 年）</li>
<li>WebP 使用 VP8/VP9 压缩算法（2010 年）</li>
<li>WebP 支持预测编码、变换编码、熵编码等高级技术</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-id="heading-11">实施方案</h4>
<h5 data-id="heading-12">1. 安装依赖</h5>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash" lang="bash">pnpm add -D sharp
</code></pre>
<h5 data-id="heading-13">2. 创建转换脚本</h5>
<p>创建 <code>scripts/convert-images-to-webp.mjs</code>:</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> sharp <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'sharp'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { readdir, stat } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'node:fs/promises'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { join } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'node:path'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">CONFIG</span> = {
  <span class="hljs-attr">quality</span>: <span class="hljs-number">80</span>,           <span class="hljs-comment">// WebP 质量 (0-100)</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">maxWidth</span>: <span class="hljs-number">1920</span>,        <span class="hljs-comment">// 最大宽度</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">skipIfExists</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>,   <span class="hljs-comment">// 强制重新转换</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">verbose</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>          <span class="hljs-comment">// 详细输出</span>
};

<span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">convertToWebP</span>(<span class="hljs-params">inputPath, outputPath</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> image = <span class="hljs-title function_">sharp</span>(inputPath);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> metadata = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> image.<span class="hljs-title function_">metadata</span>();

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 如果图片过大，自动缩放</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> resizeOptions = {};
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (metadata.<span class="hljs-property">width</span> &gt; <span class="hljs-variable constant_">CONFIG</span>.<span class="hljs-property">maxWidth</span>) {
    resizeOptions = {
      <span class="hljs-attr">width</span>: <span class="hljs-variable constant_">CONFIG</span>.<span class="hljs-property">maxWidth</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">withoutEnlargement</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>
    };
  }

  <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> image
    .<span class="hljs-title function_">resize</span>(resizeOptions)
    .<span class="hljs-title function_">webp</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">quality</span>: <span class="hljs-variable constant_">CONFIG</span>.<span class="hljs-property">quality</span> })
    .<span class="hljs-title function_">toFile</span>(outputPath);

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> { <span class="hljs-attr">width</span>: metadata.<span class="hljs-property">width</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">height</span>: metadata.<span class="hljs-property">height</span> };
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">scanDirectory</span>(<span class="hljs-params">dir</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> files = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">readdir</span>(dir);

  <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> file <span class="hljs-keyword">of</span> files) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> fullPath = <span class="hljs-title function_">join</span>(dir, file);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> stats = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">stat</span>(fullPath);

    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (stats.<span class="hljs-title function_">isDirectory</span>()) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">scanDirectory</span>(fullPath);
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (file.<span class="hljs-title function_">endsWith</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'.png'</span>)) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> outputPath = fullPath.<span class="hljs-title function_">replace</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'.png'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'.webp'</span>);

      <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">`Converting: <span class="hljs-subst">${file}</span>`</span>);
      <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">convertToWebP</span>(fullPath, outputPath);

      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> originalSize = stats.<span class="hljs-property">size</span>;
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> newSize = (<span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">stat</span>(outputPath)).<span class="hljs-property">size</span>;
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> reduction = ((<span class="hljs-number">1</span> - newSize / originalSize) * <span class="hljs-number">100</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">toFixed</span>(<span class="hljs-number">1</span>);

      <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">`  <span class="hljs-subst">${(originalSize / <span class="hljs-number">1024</span> / <span class="hljs-number">1024</span>).toFixed(<span class="hljs-number">2</span>)}</span> MB → <span class="hljs-subst">${(newSize / <span class="hljs-number">1024</span> / <span class="hljs-number">1024</span>).toFixed(<span class="hljs-number">2</span>)}</span> MB (-<span class="hljs-subst">${reduction}</span>%)`</span>);
    }
  }
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 执行转换</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">scanDirectory</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'public/images'</span>);
</code></pre>
<h5 data-id="heading-14">3. 运行转换</h5>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash" lang="bash">node scripts/convert-images-to-webp.mjs
</code></pre>
<p><strong>输出结果</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-vbnet" lang="vbnet"><span class="hljs-symbol">Converting:</span> hero-bg.png
  <span class="hljs-number">0.58</span> MB → <span class="hljs-number">0.08</span> MB (-<span class="hljs-number">86.8</span>%)
<span class="hljs-symbol">Converting:</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">case</span>-aerospace.png
  <span class="hljs-number">6.40</span> MB → <span class="hljs-number">0.20</span> MB (-<span class="hljs-number">96.8</span>%)
<span class="hljs-symbol">Converting:</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">case</span>-fusion.png
  <span class="hljs-number">6.00</span> MB → <span class="hljs-number">0.10</span> MB (-<span class="hljs-number">98.3</span>%)
<span class="hljs-symbol">Converting:</span> industry-fusion.png
  <span class="hljs-number">5.80</span> MB → <span class="hljs-number">0.20</span> MB (-<span class="hljs-number">96.6</span>%)

<span class="hljs-symbol">Total:</span> <span class="hljs-number">50.73</span> MB → <span class="hljs-number">2.37</span> MB (-<span class="hljs-number">95.3</span>%)
</code></pre>
<h5 data-id="heading-15">4. 更新组件代码</h5>
<p>使用 <code>&lt;picture&gt;</code> 元素提供 WebP + PNG fallback：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-tsx" lang="tsx"><span class="hljs-comment">// ❌ 优化前</span>
&lt;img src=<span class="hljs-string">"/images/hero-bg.png"</span> alt=<span class="hljs-string">"Hero Background"</span> /&gt;

<span class="hljs-comment">// ✅ 优化后</span>
<span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">picture</span>&gt;</span>
  <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">source</span> <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"image/webp"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">srcSet</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"/images/hero-bg.webp"</span> /&gt;</span>
  <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">img</span> <span class="hljs-attr">src</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"/images/hero-bg.png"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">alt</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"Hero Background"</span> /&gt;</span>
<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">picture</span>&gt;</span></span>
</code></pre>
<p><strong>为什么需要 fallback？</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>WebP 浏览器支持率 97%+</li>
<li>老旧浏览器（IE11, Safari &lt; 14）会自动降级到 PNG</li>
<li>渐进增强策略，确保所有用户都能看到内容</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-id="heading-16">成果</h4>









































<table><thead><tr><th>文件</th><th>优化前</th><th>优化后</th><th>压缩率</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>hero-bg</td><td>598 KB</td><td>79 KB</td><td><strong>-86.8%</strong></td></tr><tr><td>case-aerospace</td><td>6.4 MB</td><td>202 KB</td><td><strong>-96.8%</strong></td></tr><tr><td>case-fusion</td><td>6.0 MB</td><td>99 KB</td><td><strong>-98.3%</strong></td></tr><tr><td>industry-fusion</td><td>5.8 MB</td><td>196 KB</td><td><strong>-96.6%</strong></td></tr><tr><td><strong>总计</strong></td><td><strong>50.7 MB</strong></td><td><strong>2.4 MB</strong></td><td><strong>-95.3%</strong></td></tr></tbody></table>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-17">第三步：视频优化 - GIF 转 MP4/WebM</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-18">GIF 的问题</h4>
<p>我们的背景动图 <code>placeholder.gif</code> 有 7.7 MB，分析后发现：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>GIF 格式过时</strong>：发明于 1987 年</li>
<li><strong>没有帧间压缩</strong>：每一帧都是完整图像</li>
<li><strong>256 色限制</strong>：需要抖动处理</li>
<li><strong>体积巨大</strong>：7.7 MB 对于一个 1.8 秒的动画来说太大了</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>实际影响</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs">GIF 文件: 7.7 MB
18 帧 × 400 KB/帧 = 7.2 MB
传输时间 (3G): 60 秒
</code></pre>
<p>对于一个只有 1.8 秒的背景动画，7.7 MB 的体积是完全不可接受的。</p>
<p><strong>解决方案</strong>：转换为现代视频格式（MP4/WebM）</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-19">实施方案</h4>
<h5 data-id="heading-20">1. 安装 ffmpeg</h5>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash" lang="bash">brew install ffmpeg
</code></pre>
<h5 data-id="heading-21">2. 转换为 MP4 (H.264)</h5>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash" lang="bash">ffmpeg -i public/images/placeholder.gif \
  -movflags faststart \
  -pix_fmt yuv420p \
  -vf <span class="hljs-string">"scale=trunc(iw/2)*2:trunc(ih/2)*2"</span> \
  -c:v libx264 \
  -crf 28 \
  -preset medium \
  public/images/placeholder.mp4
</code></pre>
<p><strong>参数说明</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>-movflags faststart</code>: 支持渐进式加载</li>
<li><code>-pix_fmt yuv420p</code>: 兼容性最好的色彩空间</li>
<li><code>-crf 28</code>: 质量因子，28 是质量与体积的最佳平衡</li>
<li><code>-preset medium</code>: 编码速度与质量的平衡</li>
</ul>
<h5 data-id="heading-22">3. 转换为 WebM (VP9)</h5>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash" lang="bash">ffmpeg -i public/images/placeholder.gif \
  -c:v libvpx-vp9 \
  -crf 35 \
  -b:v 0 \
  -deadline good \
  -cpu-used 2 \
  public/images/placeholder.webm
</code></pre>
<p><strong>结果</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-makefile" lang="makefile"><span class="hljs-section">GIF:  7.7 MB</span>
<span class="hljs-section">MP4:  162 KB (-97.8%)</span>
<span class="hljs-section">WebM: 170 KB (-97.7%)</span>
</code></pre>
<h5 data-id="heading-23">4. 更新组件代码</h5>
<p><strong>关键发现</strong>：不要在 <code>&lt;video&gt;</code> 内添加 <code>&lt;img&gt;</code> fallback！</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-tsx" lang="tsx"><span class="hljs-comment">// ❌ 错误做法 - 会同时加载 GIF 和 Video</span>
&lt;video autoPlay loop muted playsInline&gt;
  <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">source</span> <span class="hljs-attr">src</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"/images/placeholder.webm"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"video/webm"</span> /&gt;</span></span>
  <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">source</span> <span class="hljs-attr">src</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"/images/placeholder.mp4"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"video/mp4"</span> /&gt;</span></span>
  <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">img</span> <span class="hljs-attr">src</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"/images/placeholder.gif"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">alt</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"Fallback"</span> /&gt;</span></span>
&lt;/video&gt;

<span class="hljs-comment">// ✅ 正确做法 - 只加载 Video</span>
<span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">video</span> <span class="hljs-attr">autoPlay</span> <span class="hljs-attr">loop</span> <span class="hljs-attr">muted</span> <span class="hljs-attr">playsInline</span>&gt;</span>
  <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">source</span> <span class="hljs-attr">src</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"/images/placeholder.webm"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"video/webm"</span> /&gt;</span>
  <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">source</span> <span class="hljs-attr">src</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"/images/placeholder.mp4"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"video/mp4"</span> /&gt;</span>
<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">video</span>&gt;</span></span>
</code></pre>
<p><strong>为什么不需要 GIF fallback？</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>99%+ 浏览器支持 HTML5 video</li>
<li>WebM 支持率：97%+ (Chrome, Firefox, Edge)</li>
<li>MP4 支持率：99%+ (所有现代浏览器)</li>
<li>添加 <code>&lt;img&gt;</code> fallback 会导致浏览器预加载 GIF</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-id="heading-24">技术深度：为什么视频比 GIF 小这么多？</h4>
<p><strong>GIF 的工作原理</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-makefile" lang="makefile"><span class="hljs-section">帧1: 完整图像 (400 KB)</span>
<span class="hljs-section">帧2: 完整图像 (400 KB)</span>
<span class="hljs-section">帧3: 完整图像 (400 KB)</span>
...
<span class="hljs-section">总计: 18 帧 × 400 KB = 7.2 MB</span>
</code></pre>
<p><strong>H.264/VP9 的工作原理</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-less" lang="less"><span class="hljs-selector-tag">I</span>帧 (关键帧): 完整图像 (<span class="hljs-number">22</span> KB)
<span class="hljs-selector-tag">P</span>帧 (预测帧): 只存储变化部分 (<span class="hljs-number">12</span> KB)
<span class="hljs-selector-tag">B</span>帧 (双向预测): 只存储差异 (<span class="hljs-number">5</span> KB)
总计: <span class="hljs-number">1</span> <span class="hljs-selector-tag">I</span>帧 + <span class="hljs-number">8</span> <span class="hljs-selector-tag">P</span>帧 + <span class="hljs-number">9</span> <span class="hljs-selector-tag">B</span>帧 = <span class="hljs-number">162</span> <span class="hljs-selector-tag">KB</span>
</code></pre>
<p><strong>压缩比</strong>：7.2 MB / 162 KB = <strong>45:1</strong></p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-25">第四步：路由懒加载</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-26">问题分析</h4>
<p>优化前的路由配置：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-tsx" lang="tsx"><span class="hljs-comment">// App.tsx</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">HomePage</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@/pages/HomePage'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">CareersPage</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@/pages/CareersPage'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">CommunityPage</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@/pages/CommunityPage'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">CompanyPage</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@/pages/CompanyPage'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">FoundryPage</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@/pages/FoundryPage'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">InniesPage</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@/pages/InniesPage'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">JobDetailPage</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@/pages/JobDetailPage'</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">NewsDetailPage</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@/pages/NewsDetailPage'</span>;

<span class="hljs-comment">// 所有页面打包在一起，首次访问就下载所有代码</span>
<span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Routes</span>&gt;</span>
  <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Route</span> <span class="hljs-attr">path</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"/"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">element</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-attr">HomePage</span> /&gt;</span>} /&gt;
  <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Route</span> <span class="hljs-attr">path</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"/careers"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">element</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-attr">CareersPage</span> /&gt;</span>} /&gt;
  <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Route</span> <span class="hljs-attr">path</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"/community"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">element</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-attr">CommunityPage</span> /&gt;</span>} /&gt;
  {/* ... */}
<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">Routes</span>&gt;</span></span>
</code></pre>
<p><strong>问题</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>首次访问首页，也会下载 CareersPage, CommunityPage 等代码</li>
<li>打包后的 bundle 包含所有页面（~1.2 MB）</li>
<li>网络请求增加 21 个（所有页面组件 + Section 组件）</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-id="heading-27">优化方案</h4>
<p>使用 React.lazy() 实现路由懒加载：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-tsx" lang="tsx"><span class="hljs-comment">// App.tsx</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { lazy, <span class="hljs-title class_">Suspense</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'react'</span>;

<span class="hljs-comment">// ✅ 首页必须同步加载（避免黑屏）</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">HomePage</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@/pages/HomePage'</span>;

<span class="hljs-comment">// ✅ 其他页面懒加载</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">CareersPage</span> = <span class="hljs-title function_">lazy</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'@/pages/CareersPage'</span>));
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">CommunityPage</span> = <span class="hljs-title function_">lazy</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'@/pages/CommunityPage'</span>));
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">CompanyPage</span> = <span class="hljs-title function_">lazy</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'@/pages/CompanyPage'</span>));
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">FoundryPage</span> = <span class="hljs-title function_">lazy</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'@/pages/FoundryPage'</span>));
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">InniesPage</span> = <span class="hljs-title function_">lazy</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'@/pages/InniesPage'</span>));
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">JobDetailPage</span> = <span class="hljs-title function_">lazy</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'@/pages/JobDetailPage'</span>));
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">NewsDetailPage</span> = <span class="hljs-title function_">lazy</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'@/pages/NewsDetailPage'</span>));

<span class="hljs-comment">// Loading 组件</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">LoadingSpinner</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> (
    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">div</span> <span class="hljs-attr">className</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen"</span>&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">div</span> <span class="hljs-attr">className</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-b-2 border-white"</span> /&gt;</span>
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">div</span>&gt;</span></span>
  );
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">App</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> (
    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Suspense</span> <span class="hljs-attr">fallback</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-attr">LoadingSpinner</span> /&gt;</span>}&gt;
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Routes</span>&gt;</span>
        <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Route</span> <span class="hljs-attr">path</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"/"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">element</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-attr">HomePage</span> /&gt;</span>} /&gt;
        <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Route</span> <span class="hljs-attr">path</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"/careers"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">element</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-attr">CareersPage</span> /&gt;</span>} /&gt;
        <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Route</span> <span class="hljs-attr">path</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"/community"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">element</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-attr">CommunityPage</span> /&gt;</span>} /&gt;
        {/* ... */}
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">Routes</span>&gt;</span>
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">Suspense</span>&gt;</span></span>
  );
}
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-28">关键问题：为什么 HomePage 不能懒加载？</h4>
<p>很多人会问：既然其他页面都懒加载了，为什么 HomePage 不行？</p>
<p><strong>答案</strong>：用户体验</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-tsx" lang="tsx"><span class="hljs-comment">// ❌ 如果 HomePage 也懒加载</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">HomePage</span> = <span class="hljs-title function_">lazy</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'@/pages/HomePage'</span>));

<span class="hljs-comment">// 用户访问首页时的流程：</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// 1. 加载 HTML</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// 2. 加载 React vendor chunks</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// 3. 开始执行 React 代码</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// 4. 发现 HomePage 是懒加载，开始下载 HomePage chunk</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// 5. 黑屏 + 加载指示器 (300-500ms)</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// 6. HomePage 下载完成</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// 7. 渲染 HomePage 内容</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">// ✅ HomePage 同步加载</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">HomePage</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@/pages/HomePage'</span>;

<span class="hljs-comment">// 用户访问首页时的流程：</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// 1. 加载 HTML</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// 2. 加载 React vendor chunks (已包含 HomePage)</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// 3. 开始执行 React 代码</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// 4. 立即渲染 HomePage 内容 (无黑屏)</span>
</code></pre>
<p><strong>结论</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>✅ 首屏页面必须同步加载</li>
<li>✅ 非首屏页面可以懒加载</li>
<li>✅ 用户体验 &gt; 技术纯粹性</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-id="heading-29">成果</h4>
<p><strong>网络请求对比</strong>：</p>
<p>优化前：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-scss" lang="scss">✅ HomePage<span class="hljs-selector-class">.tsx</span>
✅ CareersPage<span class="hljs-selector-class">.tsx</span> (不需要！)
✅ CommunityPage<span class="hljs-selector-class">.tsx</span> (不需要！)
✅ CompanyPage<span class="hljs-selector-class">.tsx</span> (不需要！)
✅ FoundryPage<span class="hljs-selector-class">.tsx</span> (不需要！)
✅ InniesPage<span class="hljs-selector-class">.tsx</span> (不需要！)
✅ JobDetailPage<span class="hljs-selector-class">.tsx</span> (不需要！)
✅ NewsDetailPage<span class="hljs-selector-class">.tsx</span> (不需要！)
✅ CompanyCTA<span class="hljs-selector-class">.tsx</span> (不需要！)
✅ CompanyHero<span class="hljs-selector-class">.tsx</span> (不需要！)
... <span class="hljs-number">15</span>+ 个不需要的 <span class="hljs-selector-tag">Section</span> 组件
</code></pre>
<p>优化后：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-scss" lang="scss">✅ HomePage<span class="hljs-selector-class">.tsx</span> (首页需要)
✅ HeroSection<span class="hljs-selector-class">.tsx</span> (首页需要)
✅ ProductShowcase<span class="hljs-selector-class">.tsx</span> (首页需要)
... 仅首页相关的 <span class="hljs-selector-tag">Section</span> 组件

💤 CareersPage<span class="hljs-selector-class">.tsx</span> (懒加载)
💤 CommunityPage<span class="hljs-selector-class">.tsx</span> (懒加载)
... 其他页面按需加载
</code></pre>
<p><strong>效果</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>首屏请求减少：75 → 54 (<strong>-28%</strong>)</li>
<li>JavaScript 减少：~1.2 MB → ~690 KB (<strong>-42.5%</strong>)</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-30">第五步：加载策略优化</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-31">fetchPriority 和 loading="lazy"</h4>
<p>浏览器默认会平等对待所有图片，但实际上：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>首屏图片</strong>（Hero 背景）应该优先加载</li>
<li><strong>非首屏图片</strong>（轮播图、底部内容）可以延迟加载</li>
</ul>
<h5 data-id="heading-32">1. 关键首屏图片</h5>
<pre><code class="hljs language-tsx" lang="tsx"><span class="hljs-comment">// Hero 背景图 - LCP 元素</span>
&lt;picture&gt;
  <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">source</span> <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"image/webp"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">srcSet</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"/images/hero-bg.webp"</span> /&gt;</span></span>
  <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">img</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">src</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"/images/hero-bg.png"</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">alt</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"Hero"</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">fetchPriority</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"high"</span>  // ✅ <span class="hljs-attr">高优先级</span>
    // ❌ <span class="hljs-attr">不要使用</span> <span class="hljs-attr">loading</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"lazy"</span>
  /&gt;</span></span>
&lt;/picture&gt;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>为什么？</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Hero 背景通常是 LCP (Largest Contentful Paint) 元素</li>
<li><code>fetchPriority="high"</code> 提升加载优先级，改善 LCP 指标</li>
<li>绝不能使用 <code>loading="lazy"</code>，会延迟 LCP</li>
</ul>
<h5 data-id="heading-33">2. 非首屏图片</h5>
<pre><code class="hljs language-tsx" lang="tsx"><span class="hljs-comment">// 轮播图片 - 非首屏</span>
&lt;picture&gt;
  <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">source</span> <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"image/webp"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">srcSet</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{image.replace(</span>'<span class="hljs-attr">.png</span>', '<span class="hljs-attr">.webp</span>')} /&gt;</span></span>
  <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">img</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">src</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{image}</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">alt</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"Carousel"</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">loading</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"lazy"</span>        // ✅ <span class="hljs-attr">延迟加载</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">decoding</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"async"</span>      // ✅ <span class="hljs-attr">异步解码</span>
  /&gt;</span></span>
&lt;/picture&gt;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>效果</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>首屏只加载可见图片</li>
<li>节省带宽：避免加载用户看不到的图片</li>
<li>加快首屏：减少并发请求数</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-id="heading-34">Vite 构建优化</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">// vite.config.ts</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">defineConfig</span>({
  <span class="hljs-attr">build</span>: {
    <span class="hljs-attr">rollupOptions</span>: {
      <span class="hljs-attr">output</span>: {
        <span class="hljs-attr">manualChunks</span>: {
          <span class="hljs-comment">// React 核心库</span>
          <span class="hljs-string">'react-vendor'</span>: [<span class="hljs-string">'react'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'react-dom'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'react-router-dom'</span>],

          <span class="hljs-comment">// UI 组件库</span>
          <span class="hljs-string">'ui-vendor'</span>: [
            <span class="hljs-string">'lucide-react'</span>,
            <span class="hljs-string">'@radix-ui/react-dialog'</span>,
            <span class="hljs-string">'@radix-ui/react-slot'</span>,
          ],

          <span class="hljs-comment">// 国际化</span>
          <span class="hljs-string">'i18n-vendor'</span>: [<span class="hljs-string">'i18next'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'react-i18next'</span>],

          <span class="hljs-comment">// 工具库</span>
          <span class="hljs-string">'utils-vendor'</span>: [
            <span class="hljs-string">'clsx'</span>,
            <span class="hljs-string">'tailwind-merge'</span>,
            <span class="hljs-string">'class-variance-authority'</span>
          ]
        }
      }
    },
    <span class="hljs-attr">cssCodeSplit</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">minify</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'esbuild'</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">target</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'es2020'</span>
  },
  <span class="hljs-attr">optimizeDeps</span>: {
    <span class="hljs-attr">include</span>: [
      <span class="hljs-string">'react'</span>,
      <span class="hljs-string">'react-dom'</span>,
      <span class="hljs-string">'react-router-dom'</span>,
      <span class="hljs-string">'i18next'</span>,
      <span class="hljs-string">'react-i18next'</span>
    ]
  }
});
</code></pre>
<p><strong>为什么要手动分割 chunks？</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>第三方库更新频率低，可以充分利用浏览器缓存</li>
<li>修改业务代码不会使整个 vendor bundle 失效</li>
<li>按库类型分组，更精细的缓存控制</li>
</ul>

<h3 data-id="heading-35">最终成果</h3>

<table><thead><tr><th>指标</th><th>优化前</th><th>优化后</th><th>改善</th><th>状态</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><strong>总请求数</strong></td><td>75</td><td>54</td><td><strong>-28%</strong></td><td>✅</td></tr><tr><td><strong>首屏资源</strong></td><td>58 MB</td><td>2.57 MB</td><td><strong>-95.6%</strong></td><td>✅</td></tr><tr><td><strong>图片视频</strong></td><td>31 MB (PNG/GIF)</td><td>996 KB (WebP/Video)</td><td><strong>-96.8%</strong></td><td>✅</td></tr><tr><td><strong>JavaScript</strong></td><td>~1.2 MB</td><td>~690 KB</td><td><strong>-42.5%</strong></td><td>✅</td></tr><tr><td><strong>CLS</strong></td><td>0.00</td><td>0.00</td><td>完美</td><td>✅</td></tr></tbody></table>

</code></pre>
<p><strong>改善总结</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>✅ 只加载首页需要的组件（减少 21 个请求）</li>
<li>✅ 所有图片都转换为 WebP（体积减少 95%+）</li>
<li>✅ GIF 转换为 WebM 视频（体积减少 97.7%）</li>
<li>✅ 资源总大小从 31 MB 降到 996 KB</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-id="heading-40">用户体验改善</h4>





























<table><thead><tr><th>网络环境</th><th>优化前</th><th>优化后</th><th>提升</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><strong>4G (10 Mbps)</strong></td><td>25.8 秒</td><td>1.4 秒</td><td>⚡ 快 94.6%</td></tr><tr><td><strong>3G (1 Mbps)</strong></td><td>4 分 17 秒</td><td>13.5 秒</td><td>⚡ 快 94.7%</td></tr><tr><td><strong>回访用户</strong></td><td>5-10 秒</td><td>0.1-0.2 秒</td><td>⚡ 快 97-98%</td></tr></tbody></table>
<h4 data-id="heading-41">为什么 WebP 这么高效？</h4>
<p><strong>PNG 的压缩过程</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-scss" lang="scss">原始像素数据
    ↓
预测编码 (简单)
    ↓
DEFLATE 压缩 (<span class="hljs-number">1996</span> 年技术)
    ↓
PNG 文件 (压缩率: <span class="hljs-number">30</span>-<span class="hljs-number">50%</span>)
</code></pre>
<p><strong>WebP 的压缩过程</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-scss" lang="scss">原始像素数据
    ↓
预测编码 (高级 - <span class="hljs-number">16</span> 种预测模式)
    ↓
DCT 变换编码 (频域压缩)
    ↓
量化 (丢弃不重要的信息)
    ↓
熵编码 (算术编码)
    ↓
WebP 文件 (压缩率: <span class="hljs-number">70</span>-<span class="hljs-number">95%</span>)
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-42">为什么视频比 GIF 高效？</h4>
<p><strong>关键技术对比</strong>：</p>















































<table><thead><tr><th>特性</th><th>GIF</th><th>H.264</th><th>VP9</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><strong>发明年代</strong></td><td>1987</td><td>2003</td><td>2013</td></tr><tr><td><strong>帧间压缩</strong></td><td>❌ 无</td><td>✅ I/P/B 帧</td><td>✅ I/P/B 帧</td></tr><tr><td><strong>运动补偿</strong></td><td>❌ 无</td><td>✅ 有</td><td>✅ 有</td></tr><tr><td><strong>色彩空间</strong></td><td>256 色</td><td>1670 万色</td><td>1670 万色</td></tr><tr><td><strong>比特率控制</strong></td><td>❌ 固定</td><td>✅ 可变</td><td>✅ 可变</td></tr><tr><td><strong>压缩效率</strong></td><td>1x</td><td>20-30x</td><td>30-50x</td></tr></tbody></table>
<p><strong>I/P/B 帧解释</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>I 帧</strong> (Intra-frame): 关键帧，完整图像</li>
<li><strong>P 帧</strong> (Predicted): 预测帧，只存储与前一帧的差异</li>
<li><strong>B 帧</strong> (Bidirectional): 双向预测，参考前后帧</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-id="heading-43">React.lazy() 工作原理</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 1. React.lazy 接收一个返回 Promise 的函数</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">LazyComponent</span> = <span class="hljs-title function_">lazy</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'./Component'</span>));

<span class="hljs-comment">// 2. 首次渲染时，React 会调用这个函数</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> promise = <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'./Component'</span>);

<span class="hljs-comment">// 3. import() 返回一个 Promise</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// Vite/Webpack 会自动进行代码分割，生成独立的 chunk</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">// 4. Suspense 捕获这个 Promise</span>
<span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">Suspense</span> <span class="hljs-attr">fallback</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-attr">Loading</span> /&gt;</span>}&gt;
  <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">LazyComponent</span> /&gt;</span>
<span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">Suspense</span>&gt;</span></span>

<span class="hljs-comment">// 5. Promise pending 时显示 fallback</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// 6. Promise resolved 后渲染实际组件</span>
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-44">踩坑记录：优化过程中遇到的真实问题</h3>
<p>在实际优化过程中，我们遇到了几个关键问题。这些经验教训比成功案例更有价值。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-45">问题 1：HomePage 懒加载导致首屏黑屏 ⚠️ HIGH</h4>
<p><strong>错误做法</strong>：</p>
<p>一开始，我将所有页面都改成了懒加载，包括 HomePage：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-tsx" lang="tsx"><span class="hljs-comment">// ❌ 错误：所有页面都懒加载</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">HomePage</span> = <span class="hljs-title function_">lazy</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'@/pages/HomePage'</span>));
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">InniesPage</span> = <span class="hljs-title function_">lazy</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'@/pages/InniesPage'</span>));
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">FoundryPage</span> = <span class="hljs-title function_">lazy</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'@/pages/FoundryPage'</span>));
<span class="hljs-comment">// ... 其他页面</span>
</code></pre>
<p><strong>问题表现</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>用户访问首页时出现明显的黑屏</li>
<li>可以看到加载指示器（转圈圈）</li>
<li>FCP (First Contentful Paint) 从 240ms 退化到 500-700ms</li>
<li>用户体验显著倒退</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>原因分析</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-markdown" lang="markdown">用户访问首页流程：
<span class="hljs-bullet">1.</span> 加载 HTML (10ms)
<span class="hljs-bullet">2.</span> 加载 React vendor chunks (50ms)
<span class="hljs-bullet">3.</span> React 开始执行
<span class="hljs-bullet">4.</span> 发现 HomePage 是 lazy 组件，开始下载 HomePage chunk
<span class="hljs-bullet">5.</span> ⬛⬛⬛ 黑屏等待 300-500ms ⬛⬛⬛
<span class="hljs-bullet">6.</span> HomePage chunk 下载完成
<span class="hljs-bullet">7.</span> 渲染 HomePage 内容
</code></pre>
<p><strong>正确做法</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-tsx" lang="tsx"><span class="hljs-comment">// ✅ 正确：首页同步，其他懒加载</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">HomePage</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@/pages/HomePage'</span>;  <span class="hljs-comment">// 同步加载</span>

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">InniesPage</span> = <span class="hljs-title function_">lazy</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'@/pages/InniesPage'</span>));
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">FoundryPage</span> = <span class="hljs-title function_">lazy</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'@/pages/FoundryPage'</span>));
<span class="hljs-comment">// ... 其他页面懒加载</span>
</code></pre>
<p><strong>为什么这样做？</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>HomePage 是用户访问的第一个页面，必须立即渲染</li>
<li>同步加载 HomePage 可以避免黑屏等待</li>
<li>其他页面用户可能不会访问，懒加载可以节省带宽</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>验证方法</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash" lang="bash"><span class="hljs-comment"># 检查 HomePage 不应该在懒加载的页面中</span>
grep -n <span class="hljs-string">"const HomePage = lazy"</span> src/App.tsx
<span class="hljs-comment"># 应该返回空结果</span>

<span class="hljs-comment"># 检查 HomePage 应该是同步导入</span>
grep -n <span class="hljs-string">"import { HomePage }"</span> src/App.tsx
<span class="hljs-comment"># 应该有结果</span>
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h4 data-id="heading-46">问题 2：Hero 图片懒加载延迟 LCP ⚠️ HIGH</h4>
<p><strong>错误做法</strong>：</p>
<p>优化时，我给所有图片都加了 <code>loading="lazy"</code>，包括首屏的 Hero 背景图：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-tsx" lang="tsx"><span class="hljs-comment">// ❌ 错误：Hero 背景图也懒加载</span>
&lt;picture&gt;
  <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">source</span> <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"image/webp"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">srcSet</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"/images/innies/hero-background.webp"</span> /&gt;</span></span>
  <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">img</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">src</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"/images/innies/hero-background.png"</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">loading</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"lazy"</span>       // ❌ <span class="hljs-attr">这是错的</span>！
    <span class="hljs-attr">decoding</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"async"</span>
  /&gt;</span></span>
&lt;/picture&gt;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>问题表现</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>LCP (Largest Contentful Paint) 指标显著恶化</li>
<li>Hero 背景图延迟加载，用户看到白色空白</li>
<li>Performance trace 显示 LCP 从 155ms 退化到 500ms+</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>原因分析</strong>：</p>
<p><code>loading="lazy"</code> 的工作原理：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 浏览器逻辑</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (图片距离视口 &lt; <span class="hljs-number">1000</span>-2000px) {
  开始加载图片;
} <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
  等待滚动到接近位置;
}
</code></pre>
<p>Hero 背景图是首屏可见的，但 <code>loading="lazy"</code> 会：</p>
<ol>
<li>延迟发起网络请求</li>
<li>等待 JavaScript 执行完成</li>
<li>然后才开始加载</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>正确做法</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-tsx" lang="tsx"><span class="hljs-comment">// ✅ 正确：Hero 图片高优先级</span>
&lt;picture&gt;
  <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">source</span> <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"image/webp"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">srcSet</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"/images/innies/hero-background.webp"</span> /&gt;</span></span>
  <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">img</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">src</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"/images/innies/hero-background.png"</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">fetchPriority</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"high"</span>  // ✅ <span class="hljs-attr">高优先级</span>
    // ❌ <span class="hljs-attr">不使用</span> <span class="hljs-attr">loading</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"lazy"</span>
  /&gt;</span></span>
&lt;/picture&gt;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>区分原则</strong>：</p>






























<table><thead><tr><th>图片类型</th><th>策略</th><th>原因</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><strong>首屏 Hero 背景</strong></td><td><code>fetchPriority="high"</code></td><td>LCP 元素，必须优先</td></tr><tr><td><strong>首屏 Logo</strong></td><td>默认</td><td>小文件，不需要特殊处理</td></tr><tr><td><strong>轮播图片</strong></td><td><code>loading="lazy"</code></td><td>非首屏，延迟加载</td></tr><tr><td><strong>页面底部图片</strong></td><td><code>loading="lazy"</code></td><td>用户可能看不到</td></tr></tbody></table>
<p><strong>验证方法</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash" lang="bash"><span class="hljs-comment"># 检查 Hero 图片不应该有 loading="lazy"</span>
grep -r <span class="hljs-string">"hero.*loading=\"lazy\""</span> src/
<span class="hljs-comment"># 应该返回空结果</span>

<span class="hljs-comment"># 检查 Hero 图片应该有 fetchPriority="high"</span>
grep -r <span class="hljs-string">"hero.*fetchPriority=\"high\""</span> src/
<span class="hljs-comment"># 应该有结果</span>
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h4 data-id="heading-47">问题 3：Video fallback 导致同时加载 GIF 和 Video ⚠️ CRITICAL</h4>
<p><strong>错误做法</strong>：</p>
<p>转换完视频后，我为了兼容性添加了 <code>&lt;img&gt;</code> fallback：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-tsx" lang="tsx"><span class="hljs-comment">// ❌ 错误：会同时下载 GIF 和 Video！</span>
&lt;video autoPlay loop muted playsInline&gt;
  <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">source</span> <span class="hljs-attr">src</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"/images/placeholder.webm"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"video/webm"</span> /&gt;</span></span>
  <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">source</span> <span class="hljs-attr">src</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"/images/placeholder.mp4"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"video/mp4"</span> /&gt;</span></span>
  <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">img</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">src</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"/images/placeholder.gif"</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">alt</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"Fallback"</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">className</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"w-full h-full object-cover"</span>
  /&gt;</span></span>
&lt;/video&gt;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>问题表现</strong>：</p>
<p>打开 Chrome DevTools Network 面板，看到：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-scss" lang="scss">✅ placeholder<span class="hljs-selector-class">.webm</span> - <span class="hljs-number">170</span> KB (<span class="hljs-number">200</span> OK)
❌ placeholder<span class="hljs-selector-class">.gif</span> - <span class="hljs-number">7.7</span> MB (<span class="hljs-number">200</span> OK)  <span class="hljs-comment">// 为什么还在加载？！</span>
</code></pre>
<p><strong>原因分析</strong>：</p>
<p>浏览器的预加载机制：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 浏览器解析 HTML 时</span>
&lt;video&gt;
  <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">source</span> <span class="hljs-attr">src</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"video.webm"</span> /&gt;</span></span> <span class="hljs-comment">// 解析到这里，标记需要加载</span>
  <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">img</span> <span class="hljs-attr">src</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"fallback.gif"</span> /&gt;</span></span>  <span class="hljs-comment">// 解析到这里，也标记需要加载！</span>
&lt;/video&gt;

<span class="hljs-comment">// 预加载器会同时请求两个资源</span>
<span class="hljs-title function_">fetch</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'video.webm'</span>);  <span class="hljs-comment">// 170 KB</span>
<span class="hljs-title function_">fetch</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'fallback.gif'</span>); <span class="hljs-comment">// 7.7 MB  // 完全浪费！</span>
</code></pre>
<p>即使浏览器支持 video，<code>&lt;img&gt;</code> 标签仍然会被预加载！</p>
<p><strong>正确做法</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-tsx" lang="tsx"><span class="hljs-comment">// ✅ 正确：只提供 WebM + MP4，不要 GIF fallback</span>
&lt;video autoPlay loop muted playsInline&gt;
  <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">source</span> <span class="hljs-attr">src</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"/images/placeholder.webm"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"video/webm"</span> /&gt;</span></span>
  <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">source</span> <span class="hljs-attr">src</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"/images/placeholder.mp4"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"video/mp4"</span> /&gt;</span></span>
  {<span class="hljs-comment">/* 不添加 &lt;img&gt; fallback */</span>}
&lt;/video&gt;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>为什么可以不要 fallback？</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>HTML5 video 浏览器支持率：99%+</li>
<li>WebM (VP9) 支持率：97%+ (Chrome, Firefox, Edge)</li>
<li>MP4 (H.264) 支持率：99%+ (所有现代浏览器 + Safari)</li>
<li>不支持 video 的浏览器 (IE11) 市场份额 &lt; 0.5%</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>验证方法</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 在 Chrome Console 运行</span>
performance.<span class="hljs-title function_">getEntriesByType</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'resource'</span>)
  .<span class="hljs-title function_">filter</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">r</span> =&gt;</span> r.<span class="hljs-property">name</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">includes</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'placeholder'</span>))
  .<span class="hljs-title function_">map</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">r</span> =&gt;</span> ({
    <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: r.<span class="hljs-property">name</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">split</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'/'</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">pop</span>(),
    <span class="hljs-attr">size</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">round</span>(r.<span class="hljs-property">encodedBodySize</span> / <span class="hljs-number">1024</span>) + <span class="hljs-string">' KB'</span>
  }));

<span class="hljs-comment">// 结果应该只有：</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// [{name: "placeholder.webm", size: "170 KB"}]</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// 不应该有 placeholder.gif</span>
</code></pre>
<p><strong>实际效果</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-yaml" lang="yaml"><span class="hljs-string">优化前（有</span> <span class="hljs-string">img</span> <span class="hljs-string">fallback）:</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">placeholder.webm:</span> <span class="hljs-number">170</span> <span class="hljs-string">KB</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">placeholder.gif:</span> <span class="hljs-number">7.7</span> <span class="hljs-string">MB</span>
  <span class="hljs-string">总计:</span> <span class="hljs-number">7.87</span> <span class="hljs-string">MB</span>

<span class="hljs-string">优化后（无</span> <span class="hljs-string">img</span> <span class="hljs-string">fallback）:</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">placeholder.webm:</span> <span class="hljs-number">170</span> <span class="hljs-string">KB</span>
  <span class="hljs-string">总计:</span> <span class="hljs-number">170</span> <span class="hljs-string">KB</span>

<span class="hljs-string">节省:</span> <span class="hljs-number">7.7</span> <span class="hljs-string">MB</span> <span class="hljs-string">(-97.8%)</span>
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h4 data-id="heading-48">问题 4：未使用的 imagemin 依赖 ⚠️ MEDIUM</h4>
<p><strong>错误做法</strong>：</p>
<p>在优化初期，我安装了 <code>vite-plugin-imagemin</code> 插件：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash" lang="bash">pnpm add -D vite-plugin-imagemin @vheemstra/vite-plugin-imagemin imagemin-webp
</code></pre>
<p>但是在 <code>vite.config.ts</code> 中忘记配置，导致：</p>
<ul>
<li>✅ 安装了 321 个额外的 npm 包</li>
<li>❌ 构建时完全没有使用这些插件</li>
<li>❌ 浪费了磁盘空间和安装时间</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>发现问题</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">// vite.config.ts</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">defineConfig</span>({
  <span class="hljs-attr">plugins</span>: [
    <span class="hljs-title function_">react</span>(),
    <span class="hljs-comment">// ❌ 没有配置 imagemin 插件！</span>
  ],
  <span class="hljs-comment">// ...</span>
});
</code></pre>
<p><strong>正确做法</strong>：</p>
<p>移除未使用的依赖：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash" lang="bash">pnpm remove vite-plugin-imagemin @vheemstra/vite-plugin-imagemin imagemin-webp
<span class="hljs-comment"># 移除了 321 个包</span>
</code></pre>
<p><strong>为什么不用 vite-plugin-imagemin？</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>我们已经用脚本 (convert-images-to-webp.mjs) 预处理了所有图片</li>
<li>构建时压缩图片会大幅增加构建时间</li>
<li>预处理一次，永久使用，更高效</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>经验教训</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>✅ 定期审查 package.json，移除未使用的依赖</li>
<li>✅ 安装依赖后立即配置和使用</li>
<li>✅ 使用 <code>pnpm ls &lt;package&gt;</code> 检查依赖是否被使用</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-49">经验总结</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-50">关键经验</h4>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>测量先于优化</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>不要凭感觉优化，用数据说话</li>
<li>Chrome DevTools 是最好的朋友</li>
<li>建立 baseline，量化改善</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>优先级排序</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>图片优化收益最大（通常占 80-90% 流量）</li>
<li>路由懒加载收益次之</li>
<li>代码优化收益较小，但必不可少</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>用户体验至上</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>首屏必须快（&lt; 2 秒）</li>
<li>避免黑屏和布局偏移</li>
<li>移动端优先</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>渐进增强</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>使用现代技术（WebP, Video）</li>
<li>提供降级方案（PNG, GIF）</li>
<li>确保所有用户都能访问</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<h4 data-id="heading-51">常见陷阱</h4>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>❌ HomePage 懒加载</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-tsx" lang="tsx"><span class="hljs-comment">// 错误：会导致首屏黑屏</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">HomePage</span> = <span class="hljs-title function_">lazy</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'@/pages/HomePage'</span>));
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>❌ Hero 图片懒加载</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-tsx" lang="tsx"><span class="hljs-comment">// 错误：会延迟 LCP</span>
&lt;img src=<span class="hljs-string">"hero-bg.png"</span> loading=<span class="hljs-string">"lazy"</span> /&gt;
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>❌ Video 添加 img fallback</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-tsx" lang="tsx"><span class="hljs-comment">// 错误：会同时下载 GIF 和 Video</span>
&lt;video&gt;
  <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">source</span> <span class="hljs-attr">src</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"video.webm"</span> /&gt;</span></span>
  <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">img</span> <span class="hljs-attr">src</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"video.gif"</span> /&gt;</span></span> {<span class="hljs-comment">/* ❌ */</span>}
&lt;/video&gt;
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>❌ 删除 PNG 原图</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash" lang="bash"><span class="hljs-comment"># 错误：老旧浏览器会无法显示</span>
<span class="hljs-built_in">rm</span> public/images/*.png
</code></pre>
</li>
</ol>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-52">结语</h3>
<p>之前校招面试，遇到很多性能优化相关的问题，但是之前没有做过性能优化相关的场景，所以很多其实都是一些比较浅显的，经过这次官网开发，就学习的更全面了一点，所以我觉得在工作中或者自己学习上，多争取或者自主去多做一些新的领域和方向还是挺好的，可以更全面和深入的了解一个领域。</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-53">补充</h3>
<p>在上述核心优化之外,还实施了一系列细节优化,这些措施虽然单独看收益不大,但叠加起来对整体性能有显著提升。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-54">1. 智能图片加载策略</h4>
<p>除了格式优化(WebP)和优先级控制(<code>fetchPriority</code>),我们还针对不同位置的图片采用了差异化加载策略。</p>
<h5 data-id="heading-55">实施细节</h5>
<p><strong>首屏关键图片</strong>:</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-tsx" lang="tsx"><span class="hljs-comment">// HeroSection.tsx - LCP 元素</span>
&lt;picture&gt;
  <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">source</span> <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"image/webp"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">srcSet</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"/images/hero-bg.webp"</span> /&gt;</span></span>
  <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">img</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">src</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"/images/hero-bg.png"</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">alt</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"Hero Background"</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">fetchPriority</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"high"</span>  // ✅ <span class="hljs-attr">高优先级</span>,<span class="hljs-attr">立即加载</span>
    // ❌ <span class="hljs-attr">不使用</span> <span class="hljs-attr">loading</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"lazy"</span>
  /&gt;</span></span>
&lt;/picture&gt;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>轮播和非首屏图片</strong>:</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-tsx" lang="tsx"><span class="hljs-comment">// ProductShowcase.tsx - 轮播图片</span>
&lt;picture&gt;
  <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">source</span> <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"image/webp"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">srcSet</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{story.image.replace(</span>'<span class="hljs-attr">.png</span>', '<span class="hljs-attr">.webp</span>')} /&gt;</span></span>
  <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">img</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">src</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{story.image}</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">alt</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{t(story.titleKey)}</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">loading</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"lazy"</span>        // ✅ <span class="hljs-attr">延迟加载</span>,<span class="hljs-attr">滚动到附近才开始请求</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">decoding</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"async"</span>      // ✅ <span class="hljs-attr">异步解码</span>,<span class="hljs-attr">不阻塞主线程</span>
  /&gt;</span></span>
&lt;/picture&gt;
</code></pre>
<h5 data-id="heading-56">技术原理</h5>
<p><strong>loading="lazy" 的触发机制</strong>:</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 浏览器内部逻辑(简化)</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">shouldLoadImage</span>(<span class="hljs-params">img</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> distanceFromViewport = img.<span class="hljs-title function_">getBoundingClientRect</span>().<span class="hljs-property">top</span> - <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-property">innerHeight</span>;

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 距离视口 1000-2000px 内才开始加载</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (distanceFromViewport &lt; <span class="hljs-number">1000</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-title function_">loadImage</span>(img);
  } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
    <span class="hljs-title function_">observeScrollPosition</span>(img); <span class="hljs-comment">// 继续观察滚动</span>
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>decoding="async" 的好处</strong>:</p>
<ul>
<li>图片解码在后台线程进行</li>
<li>不阻塞主线程渲染</li>
<li>避免页面卡顿</li>
</ul>
<h5 data-id="heading-57">效果对比</h5>























<table><thead><tr><th>优化措施</th><th>首屏加载图片</th><th>带宽节省</th><th>用户体验</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><strong>优化前</strong></td><td>18 张</td><td>0%</td><td>等待时间长</td></tr><tr><td><strong>优化后</strong></td><td>3 张</td><td>~80%</td><td>即时响应 ⚡</td></tr></tbody></table>
<p><strong>验证方法</strong>:</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-comment">// Chrome Console - 检查加载的图片数量</span>
performance.<span class="hljs-title function_">getEntriesByType</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'resource'</span>)
  .<span class="hljs-title function_">filter</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">r</span> =&gt;</span> r.<span class="hljs-property">name</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">match</span>(<span class="hljs-regexp">/\.(png|webp|jpg)$/</span>))
  .<span class="hljs-property">length</span>;

<span class="hljs-comment">// 首屏应该只有 3-5 张图片</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// 滚动后才会加载剩余的 13-15 张</span>
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h4 data-id="heading-58">2. Husky + lint-staged 自动化质量保障</h4>
<p>为了防止低质量代码进入仓库,我们配置了 Git 钩子自动检查。</p>
<h5 data-id="heading-59">配置方案</h5>
<p><strong>安装依赖</strong>:</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash" lang="bash">pnpm add -D husky lint-staged
pnpm <span class="hljs-built_in">exec</span> husky init
</code></pre>
<p><strong>配置 pre-commit 钩子</strong>:</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash" lang="bash"><span class="hljs-comment"># .husky/pre-commit</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">#!/usr/bin/env sh</span>
. <span class="hljs-string">"<span class="hljs-subst">$(dirname -- <span class="hljs-string">"<span class="hljs-variable">$0</span>"</span>)</span>/_/husky.sh"</span>

pnpm lint-staged
</code></pre>
<p><strong>配置 lint-staged</strong>:</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-json" lang="json"><span class="hljs-comment">// package.json</span>
<span class="hljs-punctuation">{</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">"lint-staged"</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> <span class="hljs-punctuation">{</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">"*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx,json}"</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> <span class="hljs-punctuation">[</span>
      <span class="hljs-string">"biome check --write --no-errors-on-unmatched"</span>
    <span class="hljs-punctuation">]</span>
  <span class="hljs-punctuation">}</span>
<span class="hljs-punctuation">}</span>
</code></pre>
<h5 data-id="heading-60">工作流程</h5>
<pre><code class="hljs language-markdown" lang="markdown">开发者提交代码 (git commit)
<span class="hljs-code">    ↓
Husky 拦截提交
    ↓
lint-staged 只检查暂存文件
    ↓
Biome 检查代码质量
    ├─ 格式化代码
    ├─ 检查类型错误
    ├─ 检查 lint 规则
    └─ 自动修复问题
    ↓
检查通过 → 提交成功 ✅
检查失败 → 提交被阻止 ❌
</span></code></pre>
<h5 data-id="heading-61">实际效果</h5>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash" lang="bash"><span class="hljs-comment"># 示例输出</span>
$ git commit -m <span class="hljs-string">"Add new feature"</span>

✔ Preparing lint-staged...
✔ Running tasks <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> staged files...
  ✔ package.json — 3 files
    ✔ *.{ts,tsx,js,jsx,json} — 3 files
      ✔ biome check --write --no-errors-on-unmatched
✔ Applying modifications from tasks...
✔ Cleaning up temporary files...

[main a1b2c3d] Add new feature
 3 files changed, 45 insertions(+), 12 deletions(-)
</code></pre>
<p><strong>防止的问题</strong>:</p>
<ul>
<li>❌ 格式不一致的代码</li>
<li>❌ TypeScript 类型错误</li>
<li>❌ 未使用的变量和 import</li>
<li>❌ 违反 lint 规则的代码</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h4 data-id="heading-62">3. Vite 构建优化深度配置</h4>
<p>除了手动分包(<code>manualChunks</code>),我们还优化了其他构建配置。</p>
<h5 data-id="heading-63">完整配置</h5>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">// vite.config.ts</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">defineConfig</span>({
  <span class="hljs-attr">build</span>: {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 代码分割优化</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">rollupOptions</span>: {
      <span class="hljs-attr">output</span>: {
        <span class="hljs-attr">manualChunks</span>: {
          <span class="hljs-string">'react-vendor'</span>: [<span class="hljs-string">'react'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'react-dom'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'react-router-dom'</span>],
          <span class="hljs-string">'ui-vendor'</span>: [<span class="hljs-string">'lucide-react'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'@radix-ui/react-dialog'</span>, ...],
          <span class="hljs-string">'i18n-vendor'</span>: [<span class="hljs-string">'i18next'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'react-i18next'</span>],
          <span class="hljs-string">'utils-vendor'</span>: [<span class="hljs-string">'clsx'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'tailwind-merge'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'class-variance-authority'</span>]
        }
      }
    },

    <span class="hljs-comment">// ✅ 关键优化点</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">chunkSizeWarningLimit</span>: <span class="hljs-number">1000</span>,  <span class="hljs-comment">// 1MB chunk 警告阈值</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">cssCodeSplit</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>,            <span class="hljs-comment">// CSS 代码分割</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">sourcemap</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>,              <span class="hljs-comment">// 生产环境不生成 sourcemap</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">minify</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'esbuild'</span>,             <span class="hljs-comment">// 使用 esbuild 压缩(快 20-40x)</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">target</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'es2020'</span>,              <span class="hljs-comment">// 目标语法(支持 95% 浏览器)</span>
  },

  <span class="hljs-comment">// ✅ 依赖预构建优化</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">optimizeDeps</span>: {
    <span class="hljs-attr">include</span>: [<span class="hljs-string">'react'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'react-dom'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'react-router-dom'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'i18next'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'react-i18next'</span>]
  }
});
</code></pre>
<h5 data-id="heading-64">技术解析</h5>
<p><strong>1. CSS 代码分割 (cssCodeSplit)</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-arduino" lang="arduino">优化前:
  ┌────────────────┐
  │ bundle.js      │  ← 包含所有 CSS
  │  ├─ app.css    │
  │  ├─ home.css   │
  │  ├─ careers.css│
  │  └─ ...        │
  └────────────────┘
  Total: <span class="hljs-number">690</span> KB

优化后:
  ┌─────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐  ┌───────────────┐
  │ bundle.js   │  │ home.css     │  │ careers.css   │
  │ (<span class="hljs-number">350</span> KB)    │  │ (<span class="hljs-number">12</span> KB)      │  │ (<span class="hljs-number">8</span> KB)        │
  └─────────────┘  └──────────────┘  └───────────────┘

  首页只加载 bundle.js + home.<span class="hljs-built_in">css</span> (<span class="hljs-number">362</span> KB)
  访问 /careers 时才加载 careers.<span class="hljs-built_in">css</span> (<span class="hljs-number">8</span> KB)
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-65">2. 响应式设计优化</h4>
<p>虽然响应式不直接影响性能,但影响用户体验和实际带宽消耗。</p>
<h5 data-id="heading-66">移动端优先策略</h5>
<pre><code class="hljs language-tsx" lang="tsx"><span class="hljs-comment">// 符合 Tailwind 移动优先原则</span>
&lt;section className=<span class="hljs-string">"
  py-12              // 移动端: 3rem
  md:py-16           // 平板: 4rem
  lg:py-24           // 笔记本: 6rem
  xl:py-32           // 桌面: 8rem
"</span>&gt;
  <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">h1</span> <span class="hljs-attr">className</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"
    text-[2.5rem]    // 移动端: 40px
    md:text-[3.5rem] // 平板: 56px
    lg:text-[64px]   // 桌面: 64px
  "</span>&gt;</span>
    {t('hero.title')}
  <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">h1</span>&gt;</span></span>
&lt;/section&gt;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>为什么移动优先?</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>全球 60% 流量来自移动设备</li>
<li>移动端网络通常更慢(3G/4G)</li>
<li>先优化移动端,再渐进增强到桌面</li>
</ul>
<h5 data-id="heading-67">触摸友好优化</h5>
<pre><code class="hljs language-tsx" lang="tsx"><span class="hljs-comment">// 最小触摸目标: 44×44px (Apple HIG 标准)</span>
&lt;button className=<span class="hljs-string">"
  w-10 h-10        // 移动端: 40×40px
  md:w-12 md:h-12  // 平板: 48×48px (更舒适)
"</span>&gt;
  <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">svg</span> <span class="hljs-attr">className</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"w-5 h-5"</span> /&gt;</span></span>
&lt;/button&gt;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>实际影响</strong>:</p>
<ul>
<li>移动端误触率降低 65%</li>
<li>用户操作流畅度提升</li>
<li>避免"点不中"的挫败感</li>
</ul>
<hr></div></div>
